mods.name: Alloy Ledger
mods.changelog:
- Cytra Ledger is now Alloy Ledger, with the new Alloy logo
- /ll rollback player|near: preview (counts and particles), confirm, and /ll undo. Puts back broken blocks with their facing and contents, removes placed blocks, undoes container takes and puts
- Logs full block states, container contents and exact items from now on

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- With Alloy Map on the server, it now maps everything already explored on its own when it starts (in the background, no command needed)
- Only new or changed areas get looked at after the first time
- An empty server keeps going until the map is done, then pauses as normal
- Turn it off with autoRender in config/alloymap-server.json

mods.name: Alloy Pack Mixer
mods.changelog:
Louder themed sounds
- Themed mace and trident sounds come from Alloy Pack 1.3.2: every one at full volume, with clearer sounds per theme, so they're no longer drowned out by the vanilla mace and trident sounds
- /alloysounds shows what the themed sounds are doing (setting, whether the server has Alloy FX, sounds loaded, the last one played or why it was skipped) and plays a test sound
- debugSounds in the mixer's config.json logs every themed sound for troubleshooting

mods.name: Alloy Printer
mods.changelog:
- Excluded Blocks list: the printer never places or fixes these (ids or #tags), plus a hotkey to exclude the block you look at
- Protected Blocks list: the printer never breaks these
- Strip Logs: places plain logs and strips them with an axe when you have no stripped ones
- Composter Levels: fills composters to the schematic's level
- Coral: live coral stands in for dead coral, and live coral waits for water so it doesn't die
- Break Bedrock (off by default): piston trick in survival, cleans up after itself
- Safe Observers: observers and pistons wait so nothing fires mid-build
- Pauses while the server lags, turns off when you die
- Settings button in Mod Menu and a Toggle printing key in Controls

mods.name: Alloy Shulker View
mods.changelog:
- Placed shulker boxes named Trash, Tools, Food or Blocks (any case) now use the Alloy Pack texture, like the item does. Needs Alloy Pack on; otherwise they look normal
- Works with Optimized Block Entities
- On servers without Alloy Shulker View the texture shows after you open the box once
- New setting: namedTextures (on by default)
